documents.title: Installation
documents.description: Install Vellum in a Laravel application.
documents.content: Require the package with Composer: terminalcomposer require jimmyverburgt/vellum php artisan vellum:install Then publish the config and starter docs: bashphp artisan vellum:install Start from the published stubs under resources/docs. Code blocks support titles, line highlights, line numbers, and a copy button.
